title: BlochBench task family metadata (families/<id>/family.json)
description: Summary of one task family. Generated by tools/make_family_metadata.py from the family's README.md, instances.json and task.example.json; tests/test_families.py checks that each file matches its sources and this schema.

id.description: Family id: the folder name under families/ and the first heading of README.md.

domain_name.description: Domain name, from the 'Domain' line of README.md.

tier.description: Tier, from the 'Tier' line of README.md.

tier_note.description: Text in parentheses after the tier in README.md, for example 'v1.0 candidate'; empty if none.

review_status.description: Expert review status, from the 'Tier' line of README.md (docs/REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md).

time_cap_s.description: Time cap of every instance in seconds (cap_s in instances.json; README.md states it in minutes).

grader.description: Grader file of every instance, in the instance package's private/ folder (instances.json).

instances.description: Public instances of the family, in the order of instances.json.

checks.description: Names of the automated checks, in the order of the 'Automated checks' line of README.md.

example.description: The example instance described by task.example.json.

required_outputs.description: required_outputs in task.example.json (the keys when it is an object of file names).
